headline: Lynch 52-Yarder Lifts USC Past Michigan State 35-32
dek: USC improves to 2-0 atop the Western Pacific while Michigan State falls to 0-2 and slides to No. 14 in the power poll.
body: With the game tied at 32, USC took over at its own 20 and Miller Moss hit Langston Mack for 24 yards and Kyle Ford for 21 on consecutive completions to reach the Michigan State 35. Denis Lynch then drilled a 52-yard field goal as the clock hit :13 in the fourth quarter, putting the Trojans ahead 35-32 for the final margin.

USC struck first when Rodney Linville scored on a short run at 7:36 of the first quarter to make it 7-0. Michigan State answered at :45 on a 42-yard strike from Arnold Glass to Cedric McNeil. The Trojans surged ahead 21-7 in the second quarter on a 53-yard Moss-to-Connor Burnett touchdown at 15:00 and a 98-yard drive capped by a 10-yard Moss-to-Milo Beard score at 1:58. A Keith Rocha field goal made it 21-10 at the half. Michigan State erupted for 22 unanswered points in the third quarter: a 25-yard Glass-to-Toi Bernard touchdown and two-point conversion at 10:16, a 22-yard Glass-to-McNeil strike at 8:44, and a 21-yard Sam Franklin run at 1:27 put the Spartans up 32-21. USC responded with a Lynch 44-yard field goal at 11:30 of the fourth and a Carter Myers touchdown run with a two-point conversion at 4:56 to tie it at 32, setting up Lynch's game-winner.

The box score tells the story of two aerial attacks: Moss threw for 439 yards and two touchdowns on 25-of-48 passing, while Glass countered with 388 yards and three scores on 30-of-46. Burnett led all receivers with eight catches for 201 yards and a touchdown, pushing his season total to 288 yards and the PCFL lead. Myers added 66 rushing yards and a score, raising his league-best rushing total to 152 yards. USC converted 7 of 16 third downs and both fourth-down attempts, while Michigan State went 4-for-11 on third down and did not attempt a fourth-down conversion. The lone turnover — a Rob Wilcots fumble recovered by Anthony Lucas in the first quarter — did not produce points for USC. Penalties were minimal: Michigan State 1 for 5 yards, USC 3 for 25.

USC moves to 2-0, holds the No. 2 spot in the power poll and leads the Western Pacific division. Michigan State drops to 0-2, falls to No. 14 and sits last in the Western Central at 0-2. The Spartans allowed 35 points in this game after allowing 30 per game entering the week, while the offense averaged 25 points per game entering and scored 32 here. Next week, Michigan State visits Alabama (1-1) and USC travels to Miami (0-2).
turningPoint: Denis Lynch's 52-yard field goal at Q4 :13 broke a 32-32 tie and gave USC the lead for good.
byTheNumbers: USC outgained Michigan State 526-445 in total yards, with Moss (439 passing) and Glass (388) combining for 827 yards through the air.
Connor Burnett's 201 receiving yards gave him 288 on the season, the PCFL lead; Carter Myers' 66 rushing yards pushed him to 152, also tops in the league.
USC converted 44% of third downs (7/16) and both fourth-down tries; Michigan State converted 36% (4/11) with no fourth-down attempts.
The only turnover was a Michigan State fumble lost in Q1; neither team threw an interception.

unsungHero.name: Milo Beard
unsungHero.why: Caught a 10-yard touchdown pass to cap a 98-yard drive that gave USC a 21-7 lead late in the first half, and added a 12-yard catch on the final drive before a penalty wiped it out.
